scripts.build: npm --prefix ../.. run build:offline-campaign && node --import tsx scripts/build.ts && node scripts/prepare-native.mjs
scripts.sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run sync && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-apk.ps1
scripts.check:online: node --import tsx scripts/check-online-rules.ts && node --import tsx scripts/check-online.mjs
scripts.check:player: node --import tsx scripts/check-player-rules.ts && node --import tsx scripts/check-player-browser.mjs
scripts.check:team: node --import tsx scripts/check-team-rules.ts && node --import tsx scripts/check-team-browser.mjs
scripts.check:tournaments: node --import tsx scripts/check-tournament-rules.ts && node --import tsx scripts/check-tournament-browser.mjs
scripts.check:push: node --import tsx scripts/check-push-rules.ts && node --import tsx scripts/check-push-api.ts
